settings.opinion.label: Second opinion before landing
settings.opinion.body: Another agent, one you name and best another maker's, reads work here before it lands, in a copy of its own that nothing is taken back from; its findings go to the session that did the work, and to you. A repository's rule replaces its workspace's whole, and none set anywhere is how work lands today.
settings.opinion.says.noneSet: None: no other agent reads work here.
settings.opinion.says.noneHere: No second opinion here, whatever its workspace says: no other agent reads work here before it lands.
settings.opinion.says.landing: Before work here lands, {{reviewers}} reads it, in a copy of its own that nothing is taken back from; its findings go to the session that did the work, and to you.
settings.opinion.says.steps: Before a chain's next step starts, {{reviewers}} reads the work of the step before it here, in a copy of its own that nothing is taken back from; its findings go to the session that did the work, and to you.
settings.opinion.says.stepsToo: It reads each step's work here too, before the chain's next step starts.
settings.opinion.says.verify: It may build and run what this repository declares safe, in that copy.
settings.opinion.says.required: If no reviewer can read it, the work waits for you.
settings.opinion.says.optional: If no reviewer can read it, you are told so, and nothing waits.
settings.opinion.says.minutes: One pass takes at most {{minutes}} minutes.
settings.opinion.says.noRecheck: Commits made in answer to its findings are not read again.
settings.opinion.says.sameAgentOne: {{names}} is the same agent as the one that does the work here: a fresh conversation of the same agent is not an independent reading, and each opinion says so.
settings.opinion.says.sameAgentMany: {{names}} are the same agent as the one that does the work here: a fresh conversation of the same agent is not an independent reading, and each opinion says so.
settings.opinion.says.waiting: Where work here waits for another agent's reading, it lands only once that reading is settled, or once you go on without it, `daoris-driver opinion anyway <session>`, or say you looked yourself, `daoris-driver opinion myself <session>`.
settings.opinion.says.stepWaiting: Where a chain's next step here waits for another agent's reading of the step before it, it starts only once that reading is settled.
settings.opinion.says.safeNotHanded: What this repository declares safe is not handed to a reviewer yet.
settings.opinion.reviewers: Its reviewers for {{name}}, in the order they are tried
settings.opinion.occasions: When it reads by itself, for {{name}}
settings.opinion.required: Wait for me if no reviewer can read it
settings.opinion.verify: Let it run what is declared safe
settings.opinion.minutes: Minutes one pass may take, for {{name}}
settings.opinion.saved: {{name}} has a second opinion from {{reviewers}}. Where work there waits for its reading, it goes on only once that reading is settled, or you go on without it.
settings.opinion.noneSaved: {{name}} has no second opinion now, whatever its workspace says.
settings.opinion.cleared: {{name}} takes its second-opinion rule from what stands above it again.
